description: This file defines a React functional component 'ConnectMusicCard' that provides a user interface to connect music providers like Spotify and Apple Music, including feature flag checks and dynamic import of integration modules.

methods.name: ConnectMusicCard
methods.description: React component that renders a card with options to connect music providers, conditionally rendered based on feature flags.

methods.name: onConnect
methods.description: Handles user interaction for connecting a selected music provider by dynamically importing the relevant module and initiating OAuth flow.
